candidate_selection: Among eligible candidates, select the highest mean validation reward over the seven performance scenarios. If no candidate is eligible, retain the highest-reward development candidate only for diagnosis and do not consume v5 holdout seeds.
claim_boundary: V5 remains simulator evidence. Receipt-gated handoff safety, durable ACK reconciliation, Kubernetes behavior, and 20,000 live subscriptions require separate Mumbai cluster evidence.

evidence_boundary.development_failure: If no candidate is eligible, retain the complete run, do not evaluate v5 holdout seeds, and preregister any further method change as v6.
evidence_boundary.v4_holdout: Reserved and not consumed. It will remain unused during v5.
evidence_boundary.v5_holdout: A fresh registered seed bank. It may be consumed exactly once and only by the independent evaluator after every development gate passes.

method_revision.change: Scale-down is admissible only when an idle active connection exists, the active connection count exceeds ceil(local subscriptions divided by the per-connection subscription limit), and all active-connection backlog is zero.
method_revision.instrumentation_only: The trainer and independent evaluator read candidate, validation, and holdout seeds from this enforced protocol. The central registry still verifies that the holdout bank is unconsumed.
method_revision.reason: Both v4 development runs failed the all-action gate because the frozen policies did not reliably select scale-down. Inspection also showed that the simulator and live controller needed the same capacity-aware idle-connection condition.
unchanged: seven performance scenarios and four safety scenarios

primary_endpoint.success_rule: The paired 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval has a lower bound greater than zero. A failed rule is retained and reported, not tuned away.
